title: Towards culturally-appropriate conversational AI for health in the majority world: An exploratory study with citizens and professionals in Latin America
reasoning: The paper identifies religion, spiritual leadership, and morals as important socio-cultural factors influencing health communication and incorporates them as themes in its proposed framework. However, it is a qualitative exploratory study focusing on cultural appropriateness rather than a component designed to evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
